# Two B-reserved mission columns still serialize these old permanent rewards.
# Convert each one exactly once into the intended twenty-year bridge without
# changing the frozen mission bytes.
jxp_a_106_convert_legacy_permanent_rewards_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_modifier = jxp_three_capitals_ledgers
				NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_106_three_capitals_ledgers_converted }
			}
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_three_capitals_ledgers
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_three_capitals_ledgers duration = 7300 }
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_106_three_capitals_ledgers_converted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_modifier = jxp_a_buddhist_temple_credit
				NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_106_buddhist_temple_credit_converted }
			}
			remove_country_modifier = jxp_a_buddhist_temple_credit
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_buddhist_temple_credit duration = 7300 }
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_106_buddhist_temple_credit_converted
		}
	}
}

jxp_a_reconcile_socioeconomic_system_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes
				NOT = { jxp_is_colonial_successor_tag_trigger = yes }
			}
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_founder_legacy_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_unification_method_effect = yes
			jxp_a_reconcile_japanese_estates_effect = yes
			jxp_a_reconcile_market_stage = yes
			if = {
				limit = { jxp_a_106_should_initialize_company_core_trigger = yes }
				jxp_a_initialize_company_core_effect = yes
			}
			jxp_a_reconcile_companies_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_mission_profile_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_commercial_council_effect = yes
			jxp_a_106_convert_legacy_permanent_rewards_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_106_has_any_socioeconomic_state_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_106_full_socioeconomic_cleanup_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

jxp_a_run_socioeconomic_migration_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { jxp_is_colonial_successor_tag_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_106_full_socioeconomic_cleanup_effect = yes
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_pending
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_retry_queued
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_v110
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_is_japanese_polity_trigger = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_legacy_snapshot_ready } }
				jxp_a_105_capture_legacy_mission_progress_effect = yes
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_legacy_snapshot_ready
			}
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_founder_legacy_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_unification_method_effect = yes
			jxp_a_reconcile_japanese_estates_effect = yes
			jxp_a_reconcile_market_stage = yes
			if = {
				limit = { jxp_a_106_should_initialize_company_core_trigger = yes }
				jxp_a_initialize_company_core_effect = yes
			}
			jxp_a_reconcile_companies_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_reconcile_commercial_council_effect = yes
			jxp_a_106_convert_legacy_permanent_rewards_effect = yes
			jxp_a_105_migrate_mission_schema_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { jxp_a_106_socioeconomic_migration_postconditions_trigger = yes }
				clr_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_pending
				clr_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_retry_queued
				clr_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_legacy_snapshot_ready
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_v110
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_pending
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_retry_queued } }
					set_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_retry_queued
					country_event = { id = jxp_a_socioeconomic_integration.2 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { jxp_a_106_has_any_socioeconomic_state_trigger = yes }
			jxp_a_106_full_socioeconomic_cleanup_effect = yes
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_pending
			clr_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_retry_queued
			set_country_flag = jxp_a_socioeconomic_migration_v110
		}
	}
}
